737:t_109:5.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「The power of $$真化融合$$...!」

737:t_109:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That's not all! We've beaten a lot of enemies on the way here!」

737:t_109:7.en:
$$隼人$$
「The $$インベーダー#pilot$$s, the $$宇宙怪獣$$, $$ヴィルダーク$$, the evil god army, $$アサキム$$, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$...」

737:t_109:9.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Get ready, you $$御使い$$s! We're going to surpass you!」

737:t_109:10.en:
$$竜馬$$
「And we'll keep getting stronger without limit! That's our evolution!!」

737:t_110:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「The source of every battle in the whole universe...! I'll cut it off at the root, right here!!」

737:t_110:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Is that your favorite power-of-love thing? Then it's useless, totally useless!」

737:t_110:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We discarded such crude emotional patterns 120 million years ago!」

737:t_110:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「By throwing away love, you lost the truth of the universe! As a result, you've sunk into beings who can take other people's lives without a second thought!」

737:t_110:6.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「$$テンプティ$$ and the others have sunk!?」

737:t_110:7.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「I will not allow it! For a humanity that has barely reached the threshold of evolution to deny our existence!」

737:t_110:8.en:
$$タケル$$
「I'll say it as many times as it takes! You who forgot love must not exist in this universe!」

737:t_110:9.en:
$$タケル$$
「That's why I fight! With my oath to my brother in my heart, in this $$ゴッドマーズ$$!!」

737:t_111:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「So you finally showed up, big boss! I'm going to settle this!」

737:t_111:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「This is hilarious! They actually seem to think they can beat $$御使い$$s!」

737:t_111:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Do not underestimate them, $$テンプティ$$. It is that very recklessness that has at times given strength to the Earth species.」

737:t_111:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「You guys are Earthlings too, aren't you!」

737:t_111:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「Your act as gods ends here! If you can keep that composure after taking my drill, I'll give you credit!」

737:t_112:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「If we beat that guy, it's all over!」

737:t_112:1.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Let's go, $$ノリコ$$! Staking everything we have!」

737:t_112:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Fools... Even if you were to defeat us, you would merely be swallowed by the force that seeks to vanish and disappear along with the universe.」

737:t_112:3.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「In other words, you'll be destroying the people you care about and the universe, all lumped together, with your own hands!」

737:t_112:4.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Is that all you have to say?」

737:t_112:6.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We have no interest in hearing a story that only suits you! We walk the path we believe in!」

737:t_112:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「By defeating you, who stand in front of it!!」

737:t_113:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「How pitiful. Even after losing your power, you fight with nothing held back?」

737:t_113:2.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「What a shame. If you'd gotten eternity too, you could have stayed $$トップレス$$ forever.」

737:t_113:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Even without the $$トップレス$$ ability, I'm still me! I haven't lost my will to fight!」

737:t_113:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「What eternity! I won't lose to you, who lost what mattered most by gaining it!!」

737:t_114:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「So you are one of the crystallizations of Earth humanity's wisdom.」

737:t_114:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「If so, that's laughable! No matter how hard you struggle you can't beat $$御使い$$s, and yet you come at us anyway!」

737:t_114:2.en:
$$ノノ$$
「It's true that $$ノノ$$ is clumsy and dopey, and that Big Sis sometimes says I can't read the room.」

737:t_114:3.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「It's true that $$ノノ$$ is clumsy and dopey, and that Big Sis sometimes says I can't read the room.」

737:t_114:4.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「It's true that $$ノノ$$ is clumsy and dopey, and that Big Sis sometimes says I can't read the room.」

737:t_114:5.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But! I intend to be far better than people stained by evil like you!」

737:t_114:6.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「But! I intend to be far better than people stained by evil like you!」

737:t_114:7.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「But! I intend to be far better than people stained by evil like you!」

737:t_114:9.en:
$$ノノ$$
「The worse the villain, the more they justify themselves like that!」

737:t_114:10.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「The worse the villain, the more they justify themselves like that!」

737:t_114:11.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「The worse the villain, the more they justify themselves like that!」

737:t_114:12.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Get ready, $$御使い$$s! $$ノノ$$ will fight for all the life living in this universe!!」

737:t_114:13.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Get ready, $$御使い$$s! $$ノノ$$ will fight for all the life living in this universe!!」

737:t_114:14.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Get ready, $$御使い$$s! $$ノノ$$ will fight for all the life living in this universe!!」

737:t_115:1.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「One who carries on the blood of the beast.」

737:t_115:2.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You're only the first stage of evolution! If you think you can beat higher-dimensional life forms like $$テンプティ$$ and the others, you're dead wrong!」

737:t_115:3.en:
$$くらら$$
「It seems you don't know what became of those who made arbitrary assumptions like that.」

737:t_115:4.en:
$$朔哉$$
「We beat every villain like that, and that's how we got here!」

737:t_115:5.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「The blood boiling in us... no, in all of humanity, can't be stopped by anyone!」

737:t_115:6.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「That's right! Be it fate or emissaries of God!」

737:t_115:8.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「So this is the blood of the beast...! Something we forgot long ago!」

737:t_115:9.en:
$$葵$$
「This heat will burn you all to ashes!」

737:t_116:0.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Look, look, $$ドクトリン$$! There's a salaryman in a place like this!」

737:t_116:1.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「No one else could suit the phrase 'not knowing one's place' better.」

737:t_116:2.en:
$$赤木$$
「What, is it wrong for a salaryman to fight!」

737:t_116:3.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「How stupid! If you only wanted to earn money, there are easier jobs out there!」

737:t_116:4.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「You are fools who were swept along by circumstances and blithely wandered all the way here.」

737:t_116:5.en:
$$青山$$
「I can't deny that we were swept along by circumstances, but I don't want you thinking that's all there is to it.」

737:t_116:6.en:
$$いぶき$$
「At the very least, right now we are trying to fight you of our own will!」

737:t_116:8.en:
$$青山$$
「$$赤木$$! Tell those guys who still act like they're the rulers!」

737:t_116:9.en:
$$いぶき$$
「I'm counting on you to hit them with your specialty, in one shot!」

737:t_116:10.en:
$$赤木$$
「Right! Clean out your ears and listen up, $$御使い$$s!」

737:t_116:11.en:
$$赤木$$
「We will never lose! Even salarymen can protect the peace!!」

737:t_117:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「The $$メガデウス$$, $$ザ・ビッグ$$... The power prepared by those who escaped us in order to protect their paradise...」

737:t_117:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「And that city cast off its past and future from the time of its battle with us.」

737:t_117:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see... So the memory of flames was the battle between $$ザ・ビッグ$$ and you.」

737:t_117:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「To think I'd be able to pick up lost memories in a place like this.」

737:t_117:6.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Insolent, in the face of us!」

737:t_117:7.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「It's pointless to expect common sense from $$ロジャー$$. He's free.」
